summary.intent: Execute the GSD manager command center to discuss, plan, and execute three UAT gap-closure phases (42: API unpin integrity, 43: FUSE write durability, 44: IPNS conflict handling) for the CipherBox v1.1 milestone using wave-based parallel worktree execution.
summary.outcome: Phase 42 fully closed (8 plans, 3 waves, code review, verification, todos archived). Phase 43 fully closed (8 plans across 6 waves including gap closure, code review, re-verification, UAT file written). Phase 44 researched and VALIDATION.md written; planning in progress at session end.

repo: The Kubo IPFS node runs with the `server` profile and swarm port 4001 publicly exposed (docker/docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72), which means provider records for every pinned CID are broadcast to the public DHT — CIDs are public identifiers even though blob content is encrypted.

The unpin endpoint (`POST /ipfs/unpin`) was protected only by `JwtAuthGuard` with open signup, and the handler never checked `req.user` — any authenticated user could unpin any CID they discovered, constituting a cross-tenant data-destruction surface.

Writable-share saves drop `prunedCids` without calling unpin (`shared-write.ts:450`), meaning there is no legitimate cross-user unpin path; every no-row unpin call from a different user is malicious or a race.

The upload compensation path in `ipfs.controller.ts:122` fires a global `pin/rm` on a CID that content-addressed deduplication may share with another user — a pre-existing D-13 race window documented but not fixed in this phase.
BYO-IPFS unpin was broken in both directions prior to Phase 42; the server-side fix swallows 'not pinned' errors for free without requiring special BYO handling.
gsd commit helper (`gsd_run query commit`) returns `"committed": false` as a false negative even when the commit lands — always verify with `git log` before retrying.

Phase 43 established that `cargo build -p cipherbox-fuse --features winfsp` cannot pass on macOS due to pre-existing cross-compilation failures in `windows-future` and `winfsp-sys` crates unrelated to the project's own code; `cargo check` on project crates is the correct gate.
The `cleanup-wave` helper resolves `repoRoot` from its `cwd` — running it from inside an agent worktree causes false `base_mismatch` errors; it must always be run from the repo root.
The `cleanup-wave` helper is not idempotent: already-merged entries report `branch_mismatch` on rerun, requiring a reduced manifest with only remaining entries.
`.prettierignore` was missing entirely, causing prettier to mangle `.planning/` markdown files and break VALIDATION.md test command tables during pre-commit hooks.

code.finding: New `guardedUnpin` method added: acquires `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid))`, deletes `pinned_cids` row, checks refcount in-transaction, inserts into `pending_unpins` outbox if last reference, then calls Kubo `pin/rm` post-commit best-effort. Cross-user calls emit an audit metric and return silently.
Upload compensation path calls global `pin/rm` on a CID that may be shared via content-addressed dedup — D-13 race window exists, documented with comment but not fixed in Phase 42.

New WorkerHost with two BullMQ cron jobs: `drainPendingUnpins` (calls provider not raw Kubo, error-isolates per row, publishes gauge) and `runDriftReport` (NDJSON parse, read-only, zero delete calls — detect-only drift reporting).

Full rewrite implementing `WriteQueue` with persist-backed journal: `JournalOp` enum (UploadFile | MkdirPublish), `JournalEntryStatus`, fsync-before-ack ordering, ciphertext-only journal entries. Methods: put/remove/load_all_for_vault/update_status/record_failure/ordered_for_replay.

CR-04 fix: added `reply.error(libc::EIO); return;` to the Err arm of `prepare_result` — the trailing `reply.ok()` was acking the OS after a journal fsync failure. CR-08 fix: removed `spawn_journal.remove` from the background upload thread; replay on next mount is the authoritative cleanup path.

Post-verification hotfix: `spawn_journal.remove()` call remained in the Windows WinFsp path after 43-07 execution, creating the same orphan window CR-08 was fixing on macOS/Linux. Removed in a direct inline fix after the verifier flagged it.

New standalone quota-repair script for non-BYO accounts only, dry-run guarded. Pure helper functions (`selectRowsToDelete`, `parseKuboPinLs`) extracted to `backfill-helpers.ts` with 10 unit tests for TDD coverage.
New Grafana alert rule in `CipherBox Security` group: fires when `rate(cipherbox_unpin_cross_user_attempts_total[5m]) > 0`. Uses placeholder-UID convention consistent with existing alerts.

workflow: 1Password SSH commit signing requires `dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true` on all git Bash calls; signing failures ('1Password: agent returned an error') require restarting the 1Password app — never bypass with `--no-gpg-sign`.

`pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test -- --testPathPattern=X` is broken: pnpm inserts a `--` separator and jest treats the flag as a positional regex. Correct form: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api exec jest --testPathPattern='X'`.
Worktree executor subagents must have node_modules and .husky/_ untracked dirs removed before `cleanup-wave` can merge them — include explicit CLEANUP instruction in executor prompts to avoid this.
When a merge leaves MERGE_HEAD (all conflicts auto-resolved but commit step failed), run `git commit --no-edit` to conclude it rather than aborting and re-merging.
The `zsh` multi-glob `rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules` aborts the entire command if any glob finds no matches — use single paths or explicit iteration.
Decision coverage gates require literal citation strings (e.g., `D-07:`) in plan files — grep-based gates fail on paraphrased references even when the decision is substantively covered.
For post-merge test gates in a monorepo, use targeted patterns against only the phase-touched packages to avoid RAM exhaustion; never run full monorepo test suites from subagents or orchestrators.

Phase 43 established a cross-platform gap closure pattern: execute macOS/Linux and Windows plans in parallel waves, then run a re-verification pass that flags platform-parity issues for inline hotfix rather than another full gap-closure cycle.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failed multiple times mid-session, requiring user to restart the 1Password app before commits could land — caused significant orchestration stalls.
gsd commit helper returns `"committed": false` as a false negative even when commits succeed, requiring mandatory `git log` verification after every commit attempt.
The planner agent hit a socket error ('socket connection was closed unexpectedly') after writing Phase 42 plans 01-03, requiring filesystem inspection and a manual continuation planner invocation.
`cleanup-wave` is not idempotent and fails on already-merged entries, requiring reduced manifests to be written for retry runs.
`cleanup-wave` resolves repo root from cwd — running it from inside a worktree directory caused false `base_mismatch` errors that were initially misleading.
openapi.json accumulated formatting-only drift in the main tree as a `nest build` side-effect, requiring `git checkout --` before the 42-05 worktree merge to avoid spurious conflict.
The 42-05 worktree merge left MERGE_HEAD (all conflicts auto-resolved) but the commit step failed silently — required manual `git commit --no-edit` to conclude.
Three session limit interruptions broke the execution flow mid-wave, requiring careful state inspection to avoid duplicate agent dispatch.
Accidental user keystrokes ('touring wyatt web bossy') caused two tool rejection events mid-execution, requiring explicit resume confirmation.
`.prettierignore` was missing, causing prettier pre-commit hooks to mangle markdown tables in `.planning/` files — broke a VALIDATION.md test command regex that had to be manually fixed.
Decision coverage gate D-07 failed because the grep requires a literal `D-07:` citation string — the plan covered the decision substantively but lacked the mechanical citation.
open_items: Phase 44 (IPNS conflict handling): research and VALIDATION.md complete, planning not yet started at session end — needs plan-phase, execute-phase, code-review, and verification.
Phase 42 SECURITY.md missing — `gsd:secure-phase 42` flagged as required but not yet run.

Phase 43 UAT: four runtime verification items require human testing on a real device (FUSE crash-recovery replay, tray WriteParked notification, Windows mount replay, journal file format) — tracked in `43-UAT.md`.
Writable-share `prunedCids` leak: `shared-write.ts:450` drops pruned CIDs without unpinning — creates orphaned Kubo pins and inflated quota. Deferred to a future phase.
BYO provider.unpin client wiring: BYO delete flows don't call `provider.unpin`, relying on advisory-only row removal. Deferred to a future phase.
Pending-uploads UI: tray WriteParked notification implemented, but a full pending-uploads queue UI was requested by user and captured as a deferred improvement note.
Rust FUSE three-way merge parity for Phase 44: IPNS conflict handling implemented in TypeScript SDK; Rust FUSE parity deferred per Phase 44 CONTEXT decisions.
D-13 race window in `ipfs.controller.ts:122` (upload compensation path calling `guardedUnpin` on a potentially shared CID) is documented with a comment but not architecturally resolved.
